Preparing your handwriting…

Print size & position · current page

Dimensions describe content, not paper. X/Y start at the paper’s top-left. Margins mark the safe area; use Fit or Fill to place content within it. Width/height stretch independently. Screen 100% uses CSS millimeters; check the calibration sheet for physical accuracy.

Drag corners to scale; drag edges to stretch; drag the purple grip to move. Section measurements are before page Content Scale. Arrow keys on a handle resize by 1 mm (Shift: 0.1 mm). Escape cancels a drag.

Before you print

Select Actual size / 100%, turn off browser headers and footers, and choose the exact paper size in both the browser and printer driver. For the colored design, enable background graphics. Browser “Save as PDF” uses the same page layout.

Printing on your existing refill? Choose Existing planner paper in Page setup first. Check the printer’s supported paper sizes and printable margins. Use the calibration page before loading your notebook paper.
